verdict: Campaign is generating revenue but leaking budget on weak lead conversion and near-zero Google Business Profile calls.
diagnosis: Ad spend of $4,016 produced only 2 leads and 9 purchases this period — cost per lead runs far above healthcare norms.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $4,016 spend
signals.detail: Cost per lead sits near $2,000 this period. Well above any reasonable healthcare benchmark.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 this period
signals.detail: Return on ad spend of roughly $1.47 per dollar. Positive but thin given the lead volume.

signals.headline: 1,720 clicks, only 138 landing views
signals.detail: Roughly 8% of clicks reach the landing page. Suggests tracking gaps or heavy drop-off before content loads.

signals.headline: 98 direction requests, 1 call click
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drives foot traffic intent but not phone calls. Odd for a call-focused campaign.

signals.headline: Cost per click $2.33 this period
signals.detail: In line with health and medical averages. The click side is fine; conversion is where money leaks.
